new_entities.name: Clomipramine
new_entities.description: A potent serotonin reuptake inhibiting tricyclic antidepressant sometimes used after first-line SSRI failure in obsessive-compulsive disorder.

new_entities.name: Treatment-resistant obsessive-compulsive disorder severity
aliases: Y-BOCS severity after first-line treatment failure
new_entities.description: Severity of obsessive-compulsive symptoms in patients who have not responded adequately to prior standard serotonin reuptake inhibitor treatment.

edges.effect_quant: The cleanest direct resistant-population signal comes from the 1998 placebo-controlled intravenous clomipramine trial, where 21% responded during the infusion phase versus 0% on placebo despite prior oral clomipramine failure.
edges.population: adults with obsessive-compulsive disorder who had inadequate response to prior standard serotonin reuptake inhibitor or oral clomipramine treatment
edges.mechanism: Clomipramine is one of the strongest serotonergic anti-obsessional drugs available. In resistant OCD, intravenous or pulse-loaded strategies may bypass slow oral titration, reach high effective exposure quickly, and help patients who previously failed standard SSRI dosing or even oral clomipramine.
edges.summary: The signal here is real but narrower than for first-line SSRI treatment. Resistant OCD studies suggest clomipramine, especially parenteral or pulse-loaded strategies, can reduce refractory symptom burden, but the evidence base is much smaller and more specialized than the broader OCD pharmacology literature.
edges.caveats: Most treatment-resistant evidence is built on intravenous clomipramine rather than ordinary outpatient oral prescribing, and trial sizes are small. That makes this closer to a specialist rescue strategy than a general recommendation for routine OCD care.

evidence.notes: Parenteral clomipramine for depression or obsessive-compulsive disorder: a systematic review and meta-analysis.

effect_quant.comparator: two OCD randomized trials of parenteral clomipramine versus comparison treatment in resistant OCD were too heterogeneous for pooled meta-analysis

evidence.citation: KoranLM et al 1998 Arch Gen Psychiatry
evidence.notes: Intravenous clomipramine for obsessive-compulsive disorder refractory to oral clomipramine: a placebo-controlled study.

effect_quant.comparator: intravenous clomipramine versus intravenous placebo during the blinded infusion phase; responder rates were 21% versus 0%

evidence.citation: FallonBA et al 2006 J Clin Psychiatry
evidence.notes: Pulse-loaded intravenous clomipramine in treatment-resistant obsessive-compulsive disorder.

effect_quant.comparator: intravenous versus oral pulse-loaded clomipramine; intravenous loading did not outperform oral loading on Y-BOCS at day 6 or week 12
